as_told.title: 4chan whistleblower says built-to-spec UFOs lie on the ocean floor

plain: An anonymous person on 4chan, an online message board where anyone can post without a name, claimed to be a whistleblower and said that UFOs are built to order for specific jobs. The online researcher UAPGerb repeats one version, pointing to the post and to a name, Chris Ramsay. In his telling, there are places in the Bahamas that house "that large hamburger shaped mother ship that 3D prints UFOs to spec." UAPGerb adds "if that 4chan whistleblower is to be believed." Michels gives his own version in an episode with a treasure hunter named Dennis Asberg. He says the poster claimed these UFOs are "built to spec," made for set purposes, and that they sit on the ocean floor. His telling does not mention the hamburger shape or the Bahamas. The tellers raise it because, if true, it would mean a factory for craft is hidden under the sea not far from the United States.
